contract.precondition: self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
contract.postcondition: let total: Real = self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->sumBy(line: SalesLineItem | line.Subamount) in self.CurrentSale.Amount = total and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and result = total and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = self.CurrentSale.IsComplete@pre
